sentences.text:
Heard o n I.A. No. 5227 of 2024 & No.5298 of 2024, which are third repeat applications under Section 389 (1) Cr.P.C. for suspension of sentence and grant of bail moved on behalf of appellants No.2 Rajesh and No.4 Kuldeep respectively.
2. Both the appellants stand convicted under Section 376(D) of IPC and sentenced to undergo life imprisonment with fine of Rs.10,000/- and additional one year R.I. in default of payment of fine and also under Section 450 of IPC and sentenced to undergo five years' R.I. with fine of Rs.2,000/-
and additional one year's R.I. in default of payment of fine and additional two years R.I. for default of payment of fine vide judgment of conviction and order of sentence dated 15/03/2014 passed by the Additional Sessions Judge, Karera Distt.
Shivpuri in ST No.165 of 2013.
3.

entities.text:
Additional Sessions Judge, Karera Distt.
Shivpuri
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: As per prosecution story, on 19.03.2013 around 1.00 in the night, prosecutrix was sleeping in his house and her sister was sleeping outside the house.

Then, the accused Jitendra, Rajesh, Mahipal,
Kuldeep and one another person, whose name she did not know, came armed with weapons and started beating the complainant's parents.

Hearing the hue and cry, the complainant and her sister got up and the accused Jitendra and Rajesh got the victim (PW2) (her uncle's daughter) took her to the hut and both of them committed rape on her.
Mahipal and Kuldeep caught hold the hands of the victim (PW1) and took her to the hutment and both of them forcibly committed rape on her.
Another person was standing there, locking his parents in a room.
Later, when his uncle Kachhuram and Chunni Ram arrived, all the accused fled away.
On filing of written complaint to this effect, Crime No.97 of 2013 was registered at police Station Karera for the sections 376(D) and 450 of IPC and 4/6 of POCSO Act.
Statement of prosecutrix was recorded.
She was referred for medico-legal examination.

Upon completion of investigation including recording of statements, collection of evidence and necessary formalities,

sentences.text: Case was committed to the Court of Sessions.
The Sessions Court, on appreciation of evidence placed on record, convicted and sentenced the present appellants as mentioned above.

4. Learned counsel for appellants submits that appellant No.2 Rajesh has undergone actual jail sentence for 10 years, 6 months and 09 days and appellant No.4 - Kuldeep has undergone actual jail sentence for 10 years 06 months and 02 months.
It is also submitted that allegations against all the accused persons are identical.
That apart, the appeal being of 2013 is not likely to be decided in near future.
It is further submitted that co-appellant Mahipal Singh has already been granted benefit of suspension of sentence vide order dt.06.03.2024 passed in this appeal.
Appellants claims parity in treatment.
On these grounds, it is prayed that remaining jail sentence of appellants No.1 and 4 be suspended.
5 . Per contra, learned counsel appearing on behalf of the respondent/State opposed the application and prays for its rejection.

6. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, coupled with the fact that final conclusion of the appeal will take considerable long time and co- appellant Mahipal Singh has already been granted benefit of suspension of sentence, without commenting on the merits of the case, we deem it proper to suspend the remaining jail sentence of present appellants.

7. Accordingly, I.A.Nos.5227/2024 and 5298/2024 are allowed and the execution of remaining jail sentence of appellants No.2 - Rajesh and No.4 - Kuleep is hereby suspended till the final disposal o f this appeal and it is ordered that both the appellants be released on bail on their depositing the fine amount, if not already deposited, and upon furnishing a personal bond for a sum of Rs.1,00,000/-
(Rs. One Lac Only) each with one solvent surety each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, with a further direction to appear before the Registry of this Court on 23.09.2024 and on such other dates, as may be fixed by the Registry of this Court in this regard during the pendency of this appeal.
C.C. as per rules.

(VIVEK RUSIA) (SANJEEV S KALGAONKAR)
 JUDGE JUDGE  SP SANJEEV KUMAR PHANSE 2024.05.17 17:24:11 +05'30'
